question: Does the absolute magnitude of any strategy's native causal decision feature separate its stressed return per planned-risk dollar with enough temporal breadth and economic magnitude to justify one later strategy-specific, entry-preserving strength-allocation experiment?

fixed_reconstruction.event_identity: Preserve every distinct full CSV row. state_sequence is a state version and may repeat; it is not used as a uniqueness key.
fixed_reconstruction.ordering: Within each period order by parsed server_time, numeric state_sequence, fixed event precedence and then source path plus source line. SIGNAL_DECIDED precedes OPEN or PASSIVE_PLACE; PASSIVE_FILL precedes lifecycle release at an equal timestamp.
fixed_reconstruction.market_lifecycle_birth: For RC16, RC4, Cross, Pressure and Return, OPEN begins a lifecycle and supplies birth planned_risk.
fixed_reconstruction.passive_lifecycle_birth: PASSIVE_PLACE stores signal and planned_risk; only a later PASSIVE_FILL begins an admitted Passive lifecycle. PASSIVE_EXPIRE creates no lifecycle.
fixed_reconstruction.lifecycle_release: CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE ends the active lifecycle and value_b is native stressed net USD.
fixed_reconstruction.signal_link: Consume the latest earlier same-component SIGNAL_DECIDED for the corresponding OPEN or PASSIVE_PLACE. No later or reused signal is permitted.
fixed_reconstruction.stressed_r: lifecycle close value_b divided by birth planned_risk
fixed_reconstruction.direction: SIGNAL_DECIDED.value_b is retained descriptively but does not define another feature transform.
fixed_reconstruction.tail_construction: Separately inside every strategy-period, sort by native_strength ascending, then entry server time and birth sequence. LOW is the first floor(n/3), HIGH is the last floor(n/3), and the middle is excluded from the tail difference.
fixed_reconstruction.pooled_spearman: Average-rank Spearman correlation between native_strength and stressed_r over every lifecycle of one strategy across all four periods.
fixed_reconstruction.period_spearman: The same Spearman correlation separately in each period.
fixed_reconstruction.pooled_tail_difference: Mean stressed_r across all HIGH observations minus mean stressed_r across all LOW observations for one strategy.
fixed_reconstruction.period_tail_difference: HIGH mean stressed_r minus LOW mean stressed_r in each strategy-period.

fixed_integrity_gate: All six event files retain their declared hashes and contain zero exact duplicate full rows.
Every signal is consumed at most once by a market OPEN or Passive placement opportunity.
Every admitted lifecycle has one positive planned_risk and exactly one CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE; no strategy overlaps itself.
Reconstructed totals are exactly 2,233 lifecycles: RC16 272, RC4 206, Cross 805, Pressure 118, Return 238 and Passive 594.
Per-period strategy lifecycle counts match the frozen final component evidence and stressed nets sum to 407.0477 USD.

requirements: At least 50 lifecycles pooled and at least 10 in every period.
Absolute pooled Spearman correlation between native_strength and stressed_r is at least 0.20.
At least three of four period Spearman correlations share the pooled sign.
Absolute pooled HIGH-minus-LOW mean stressed_r is at least 0.10R per lifecycle.
At least three of four period tail differences share the pooled tail sign.
The pooled Spearman sign and pooled tail-difference sign agree.
fixed_information_gate.selection: Select at most one passing strategy by larger absolute pooled Spearman, then larger absolute pooled tail difference, then more same-sign period correlations, then lexicographic strategy name.
fixed_information_gate.passing_action: Retain one later Lab strength-allocation experiment for only the selected strategy. Every frozen base entry must remain eligible at no less than its base minimum lot; the whole portfolio may not lose entry count, risk remains under the unchanged 4%/12% gates, and Live remains unauthorized.
fixed_information_gate.failure_action: Close with no strength-allocation candidate. Do not rescue with signed feature, margin-to-threshold, nonlinear transform, ML, alternate quantiles, per-direction split or period-specific exception.

stop_rules: Run exactly one aggregation over the six frozen files.
Do not inspect or transform any other signal field.
Do not run MT5 or modify MQL in this unit.
Do not infer that stronger signals should automatically receive more risk.
Do not alter, query or restart Live.
